# Project instructions

## Project shape

- This is a dependency-free, single-page portfolio website. Keep structure in [`index.html`](../index.html), presentation in [`style.css`](../style.css), and browser behavior in [`script.js`](../script.js).
- Prefer semantic HTML, accessible labels, keyboard-friendly controls, and responsive CSS before adding JavaScript.
- Keep the visual system consistent with the existing dark theme, CSS custom properties, typography, spacing, and card patterns.
- Keep portfolio content factual to the information supplied in the page; do not invent employers, metrics, links, or project claims.

## Editing and validation

- For UI changes, make focused edits in the relevant HTML, CSS, or JavaScript file rather than introducing a framework or build system.
- Preserve the working `mailto:` contact flow and external profile links when changing contact UI.
- After editing, validate the page with a browser or static HTML check when available. There is currently no package manager, test runner, or build command in this repository.
- Do not add dependencies unless the request explicitly requires them and the dependency setup is documented.
